result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but two issues stand out: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab for the current screen, and the favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling. A minor thumbnail inconsistency was also noted.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active/selected tab (green icon and label) while the visible content is clearly the Home feed (delivery address, search, categories, restaurant carousels).
issues.suggestion: Sync the active navigation state with the rendered route so 'Home' is highlighted on the home feed.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the first is a white circle with a dark outline heart, the second is a dark/near-black circle with a white heart. Inconsistent treatment of the same control.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent button style (e.g. semi-transparent white circle with dark heart) for all favorite toggles, ensuring adequate contrast over any image.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a light gray background while the neighboring cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven and the white duration pill on it slightly lower contrast.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (consistent image overlay/gradient) so cards in the carousel share the same visual weight and the pill text remains legible.
